description: Lists Up/Down markets of one market_type for one coin. Use it to find a market_id before reading snapshots or a price series. Returns market rows, newest first by start time, each with its window, opening and closing spot price, winner, volume, and status. Use status, not winner, to tell whether a market is still running. coin is btc, eth, or sol, and 4hr and 24hr markets exist for btc only. start_time and end_time filter on the market start time. PolyTest loads new markets in batches, and note says so when the newest market is hours old. Costs 1 API request. To continue, call again with offset set to next_offset while stop is "more". stop "tier_window" means the plan does not cover the requested markets. If truncated is true, rows were cut to keep the result small and next_offset points at the first cut row.

coin.description: Coin symbol in lowercase: btc, eth, or sol. 4hr and 24hr markets exist for btc only.

end_time.description: ISO 8601. Keeps markets that start at or before this time. No zone means UTC.

offset.description: Rows to skip. Pass next_offset from the previous page.

start_time.description: ISO 8601. Keeps markets that start at or after this time. No zone means UTC.

name: polytest_list_markets

price_end.description: Coin spot price when the window closed. Null until it is recorded.

price_start.description: Coin spot price when the window opened.

status.description: upcoming: not started. open: the window is still running. resolved: the winner is known. ended_no_result: the window closed and PolyTest has no result for it.

winner.description: Winning side once the market resolves. A tie resolves Up.

next_offset.description: Offset of the next page when stop is more.

truncated.description: True when rows were cut to keep the result small.

title: List markets
